items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: The name 'Dick Allen' is mentioned by the Interviewer as a participant in the recording session ('my name is Dick Allen'), but the Interviewee (Christopher Goldstone) does not mention Dick Allen in his response or any other part of the provided transcript.

ctx.x: Christopher Goldstone. What do they call you? Happy.

Happy. Let's see, this is the first reel, reel one. And what's today's date? It's April the... Let me see. Must be the 11th, huh? April the 10th. April the 10th. This is Wednesday. Yeah, and this is Wednesday, 1962. Okay, Lolly, you want to say something? Put your name. Okay, Marjorie Zander. Okay, my name is Dick Allen. We can check it now. See, when we stopped, when Russell and I were here, we stopped on Jesse Jackson. You just started telling us about that. Oh, yeah. What about that band? You just had…

Well, that band was the Golden Leaf. And Jesse Jackson was the manager. And I played with Jesse on the arm. Long time. Long time. Long years. And it was me, Jesse Jackson. Bud Russo. And the big Collins. And Arthur. A little Arthur. What did Arthur play? He played clarinet.
